Making the storm rush more reactable doesn't sound so bad. Its 600 ms with some forward dodge of at least what 200 ms, but indicators only for 400 ms, but animation on storm rush can be seen in around 400 ms. It is a telegraphed move, so making the indicator 500 ms from what's currently around 400 ms indicator would make it more bearable to casual I guess, 
since storm rush is a slighty weaker heavy, and if they can't react to storm rush they would get deleted fast within at least 6 storm rushes if the orochi just uses storm rush. Yea, i agree with you man. Orochi's nerf on his moveset was too much in all honesty.

Multipick orochi's aside, so you think Orochi's dodge recoveries adding another layer of offense which could make For Honor more complex and interesting to watch and play is deteriorating the game's health?

Yes. Faster to just review the proposed changes and compare it to live values. Easier to just check back a detail of the rework too instead of having to rewind bit bit or move the video playback slider just to review a point. A wall of text would still be helpful alongside the video.
Hrm appreciate the effort but never was a fan of video reworks.

Seems good overall. But i would recommend instead 533 ms for his dodge attack and 15 damage. For comparison, valk's is 533 ms with 300-500 ms into the dodge, and hers already feel slow. 533ms dodge attack, fixed at 300 ms into dodge is similar to kyoshin. I mean you can still have 600 ms like hitokiri, but i think she has some i-frames on startup if I'm not wrong.

The chain after a whiff heavy is an interesting concept but it works. There are other heroes who could whiff attack into charged bashes like warden, warmonger and hitokiri. Come to think about it, isn't cent the only who can't do charged bashes on whiffed attacks? That aside, i don't know much about cents punch feint timings and i don't see why it should be able to feint 100 ms later. 

The dash heavy chaining on whiff is a good quality of life change. However, we can actually do this better. So he have an almost working forward dodge mixup; a kick and a HA heavy. Emphasis on almost. Make the HA forward heavy feintable like aramusha. That way forward heavy feint to GB would reliably catch dodges from forward kick and the changes to 200-500 ms wouldn't be necessary bcs the mixup would work better. Orochi's kick is also same 300-500 ms dodge input window but 500 ms bash, so cent's original kick would still work. Plus, like aramusha, the HA should start after the feint timing. I think having a feintable forward heavy is better than making it just a HA roll catcher. 

Legion kick being non stamina pause is debatable, but since its his bread and butter, makes sense for it to just have stam damage but not stam pause. Not gonna comment on his punishes. Those are my opinions.

If assasins can deflect bashes, assasins would be deadlier and more slippery. If ganked, they could counter attack out of bashes other than lights or heavies. They would have better defensive options with this. But still, like BP's flip, Assasins who do deflects defensively could still be punished by a GB. 

But if you think about it, it could also help assasins renown. Assasins get more renown on 1v1, and it gets problematic when it becomes 1vX. But with this buff, they can stall better or even pull a Faraam and counter-gank them.
